threshold_description: 1er Tribunal Ambiental ordered halt to water extraction from Lagunillas aquifer for 90 days; measure imposed as precautionary order
resolution_description: Extended Dec 2021 by 3 months; revoked 14 Feb 2022 and replaced with reduced extraction permit (minimum 54 L/s up to RCA maximum)
notes: This was a precautionary (cautelar) measure, not a penalty; related to legal challenge against water extraction licence from Lagunillas aquifer (Pampa Tamarugal system)

threshold_description: 1er Tribunal Ambiental imposed new precautionary measure with restrictions on water use; operations scaled back with last blast Q4 2022
resolution_description: Mine entered planned closure trajectory; last cathode harvest November 2023 following expiry of RCA (December 2023)
notes: Water restrictions contributed to mine closure decision alongside expiring RCA; Lagunillas aquifer depletion concern in Pampa Tamarugal system

threshold_description: Resolución de Calificación Ambiental (RCA) expired December 2023; operation did not obtain extension; mine permanently closed
resolution_description: Permanent closure; closure and rehabilitation plan filed; BHP parent committed to financial support for closure obligations
notes: EY audit noted emphasis of matter: environmental licence expired Dec 2023. RCA had been obtained Oct 2015 to extend life to Dec 2023. No further extension obtained.

threshold_description: RCA N°16/2018 contested by community of Cuncumén via Art.53 Law N°19.880; challenge to Complementary Environmental Resolution governing expanded operations
resolution_description: Ongoing legal proceedings; mine continued operations while challenge pending
notes: Community of Cuncumén in Choapa Valley is directly downstream of Los Pelambres tailings facility; water quality and quantity concerns

threshold_description: Community mobilizations and road blockades in Choapa Valley protesting mine operations; disruption to supply chain and contractor access
resolution_description: Los Pelambres accelerated Somos Choapa community investment; desalination plant fast-tracked
notes: Road blockades ('tomas de camino') indicate breakdown in community relations during peak drought stress period

threshold_description: Fatal accident at Puerto Patache: catastrophic failure of Shiploader killed one worker; immediate closure of port by authorities and Sernageomin investigation
resolution_description: Port reconstructed; operations resumed through alternative ports (Arica, Iquique, Antofagasta) during Patache closure
notes: Sernageomin conducted fatality investigation per Chilean mining safety regulations; port restoration required regulatory approval to reopen

threshold_description: Collective bargaining process resulted in 44-day legal strike by Sindicato N°1; contract expired 31 Jan 2017; union invoked Art.369 Labour Code March 2017 to end strike
resolution_description: Strike ended with union invoking Art.369 extending expired contract by 18 months; Sindicato N°2 signed new 36-month agreement Oct 2017
notes: Production impact: ~317 kt gap vs prior year (2017=925kt vs 2018=1,243kt). Second collective negotiation in April 2018 also failed to reach early agreement.

threshold_description: Maipo River basin water rights under review; DGA and Codelco-Anglo American Sur water use monitored given Santiago metropolitan water stress and upstream mining impacts
resolution_description: Ongoing monitoring under Maipo River basin management; Los Bronces mine at 3,500 masl uses glacial meltwater and River Maipo tributaries
notes: El Niño 2015-16 reduced Maipo River flows; mining water use scrutinized given downstream Santiago agricultural and municipal needs

threshold_description: QB2 construction required multiple complementary environmental commitments and monitoring; 'Incumplimiento de estándares medioambientales y compromisos' listed as key risk
resolution_description: QB2 commissioned 2023 with all environmental commitments under active monitoring; continental water eliminated upon full QB2 commissioning
notes: 2022 AR explicitly lists environmental standard non-compliance as a risk factor for QB2 construction phase

threshold_description: Rajo Inca ramp-up challenges affected Salvador Division performance in 2023; operational disruptions noted in annual report
resolution_description: Rajo Inca project ongoing; production recovery expected as open-pit transition stabilises
notes: Rajo Inca = open-pit conversion project at Salvador mine; replaces aging underground block-cave operations
